# Cathcart Group

> Cathcart Group is a fully integrated multifamily real estate company founded in 1984 and headquartered in Charlottesville, Virginia. Through its three divisions — Cathcart Development, Cathcart Construction, and Cathcart Property Management — it develops, builds, owns, and manages luxury apartment communities. The company owns 2,200+ completed units, manages $500M+ in assets, and has 1,000+ units in planning across Virginia, Alabama, and Montana.

Key facts:
- Founded: 1984 by Rip Cathcart (as Cathcart Properties; rebranded to Cathcart Group in 2010)
- CEO: Todd Dofflemyer · Chairman: Rip Cathcart
- Headquarters: 200 Reserve Blvd. Suite 300, Charlottesville, VA 22901
- Phone: 434-282-2800 · Email: info@cathcartgroup.com
- Purpose: "We improve communities and lifestyles."
- Strategy: long-term hold of Class A luxury multifamily communities

## Current Communities
- Carriage Hill — Charlottesville, VA (304 units)
- The Gallery at Godwin — Suffolk, VA (255 units, mixed-use podium)
- Lakeside Apartments — Charlottesville, VA (348 units)
- The Reserve at Belvedere — Charlottesville, VA (294 units)
- The Reserve at Daleville — Daleville, VA (188 units)
- The Reserve at Rivington — Chester, VA (276 apartments + 45 townhomes)
- The Reserve at Stone Port — Harrisonburg, VA (408 units)
- The Wentworth — Harrisonburg, VA (271 units, opened 2025)

## Upcoming Developments
- The Reserve at Winchester — Winchester, VA (444 units, Phase 1: 2027)
- The Gallery at South Peak — Roanoke, VA (260 units, 2029)
- The Reserve at Rangeline — Mobile, AL (270 units Phase I, 2028)
- Sapphire Place — Missoula, MT (297 units, 2028)
